descFull: Oyenza Studio (formerly Oyen Poni): a living notch (Dynamic Island) for Windows and Mac. Music with synced lyrics, a focus timer, a file shelf your phone can drop into, tasks, clipboard history and live system stats. Native Rust, free and open source.
